=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py:240-327 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The bash harness still sources watchdog_helpers.sh and directly calls deleted codex_run_budget_* functions, so the tests abort with command not found under set -eu.
  WHY: The removed helper definitions no longer exist in the sourced file, so the first direct call exits non-zero before any assertions can run.
- tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py:466 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The heartbeat regex still expects budget_elapsed_secs and budget_remaining_secs on stall-guard CODEX_HEARTBEAT lines, but those fields were removed.
  WHY: The emitted log line no longer matches the expected pattern, so the regex assertion fails.
- tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py:486-487 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The static contract test still requires literal budget_elapsed_secs and budget_remaining_secs strings in scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, but they were deleted.
  WHY: The file-content assertion now fails because those strings are absent from the modified script.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:216-219,393-406 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Removing _budget_suffix_for_now() and changing the heartbeat emission line strips budget telemetry from stall-guard CODEX_HEARTBEAT output.
  WHY: Stall-guard heartbeats now differ from codex_heartbeat.sh and no longer expose the budget fields that downstream greps, parsers, and tests expect.
- scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh:5-184 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The public codex_run_budget_* helper API and normalize_review_soft_deadline_minutes were deleted without replacement.
  WHY: Any direct consumer that sources watchdog_helpers.sh and invokes those functions will now hit command not found, breaking external scripts and tests.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:39-42,95-101 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The guarded budget helper calls now silently no-op when watchdog_helpers.sh no longer defines them.
  WHY: The reviewer pre-run budget note and audit logging disappear even though the script otherwise keeps running.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:14-15,1677-1683 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The guarded budget helper calls now silently no-op when watchdog_helpers.sh no longer defines them.
  WHY: The apply-fixes path loses its budget audit/logging signal without any explicit error.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6144-6155 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The summary step reads CODEX_RUN_BUDGET_TOTAL_SECS and CODEX_RUN_BUDGET_START_EPOCH even though no workflow path now initializes them.
  WHY: sanitize_nonnegative_int turns the missing env vars into zero, so the structured summary emits zeroed budget telemetry on every run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6144-6556 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The Python summary heredoc is wrapped in `|| true`, and its failure fallback emits a generic summary with zeroed budget fields.
  WHY: When the heredoc crashes, the workflow still logs a misleading success-shaped fallback and discards the traceback.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6360 | severity=nit | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: commit_phase_observed is computed with any(env(key).strip() for key in ...) instead of the boolean helper used everywhere else.
  WHY: Any non-empty string would count as true, so the expression is misleading and inconsistent even though the surrounding if/elif order still works.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5063,6384-6397 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: A skipped push is reported as push_failed because AUTOFIX_EDITS_PUSHED is only set on the success path.
  WHY: When the workflow intentionally does not attempt a push, the summary still classifies it as a failed push, which misleads operators.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:1660-1669 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The contract assertions only check that guarded helper references still appear in the scripts, so they pass even after the helpers are removed.
  WHY: The test provides a false green signal and does not catch the direct-call regressions in the deleted budget helpers.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Contract tests pin the summary shape and log/summary-step wiring."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py and tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The PR removes budget helper functions from watchdog_helpers.sh and budget telemetry from codex_stall_guard.sh but does not update the corresponding tests in test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py or test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py, so the contract tests will break.
- requirement: "Every run reaches an additive structured summary emission path in review_autofix.yml."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The summary step runs unconditionally and the Python heredoc has a fallback sentinel, so this requirement is satisfied.
- requirement: "The summary includes the budget numbers exposed by the soft-deadline foundation and placeholder-safe fields for later resume/finalize phases."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml summary step
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The summary JSON includes budget_elapsed_secs, budget_total_secs, budget_remaining_secs, and resume_round defaults to 0, so this requirement is satisfied.
- requirement: "README documents where operators should look for the structured run summary and what the major fields mean."
  expected_change_site: README.md
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The PR adds a "Run summary contract" section documenting where to find the summary and what the major fields mean, so this requirement is satisfied.
- requirement: "Contract tests pin the summary shape and log/summary-step wiring."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py (and direct-call tests)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The PR updates the summary-shape assertions but does not cover the removed budget helpers; tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py and scripts/dev/test_watchdog_helpers.sh still reference deleted functions and will fail, and no test asserts the full JSON shape or fallback behavior.
- requirement: "Land the summary contract and data plumbing now; later phases may add values to already-declared fields, but they must not rename the summary keys or drop required fields once introduced."
  expected_change_site: README.md + contract tests
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: README does not explicitly state the immutability/evolution contract, and the tests do not pin the exact JSON schema or forbid key renames/drops.
- requirement: "Include, at minimum, completed vs skipped phases, per-slot attempt counts/failure classifications, elapsed vs. total budget, finalize reason, whether edits were pushed, and the resume-round counter field."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml summary step
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: All fields are present, but budget values are zeroed and edits_pushed/push_failed distinction is imprecise.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
File: tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py
Line or code reference: 241-327 (test_run_budget_export_normalizes_soft_deadline_and_populates_env, test_run_budget_export_accepts_zero_padded_soft_deadline, test_run_budget_export_ignores_unknown_initialize_keys, test_run_budget_summary_and_gate_share_the_same_contract)
Problem: Four test functions directly source scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh and call codex_run_budget_export, codex_run_budget_initialize, codex_run_budget_summary, and codex_run_budget_phase_may_start. These shell functions were deleted from watchdog_helpers.sh in this PR.
Why it fails at runtime: Each test constructs a bash harness with set -eu, sources watchdog_helpers.sh, and calls the removed functions. Bash will exit immediately with command not found since the function definitions no longer exist in the sourced file.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

File: tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py
Line or code reference: 466 (test_stall_guard_budget_suffix_appears_on_heartbeat_lines)
Problem: The runtime test asserts a regex matching CODEX_HEARTBEAT: phase=stall_guard_budget_test elapsed_secs=(\d+) budget_elapsed_secs=(\d+) budget_remaining_secs=(\d+). The _budget_suffix_for_now() Python function was deleted from codex_stall_guard.sh in this PR, so stall-guard heartbeat lines no longer carry budget_elapsed_secs and budget_remaining_secs fields.
Why it fails at runtime: The regex will fail to match because the stall-guard heartbeat now emits only CODEX_HEARTBEAT: phase=... elapsed_secs=... without the budget suffix.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

File: tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py
Line or code reference: 486-487 (test_stall_guard_script_and_callers_keep_the_expected_contract, expectations dict for scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh)
Problem: The static contract test asserts that the file scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh contains literal strings "budget_elapsed_secs" and "budget_remaining_secs". These strings were removed along with _budget_suffix_for_now().
Why it fails at runtime: The test reads the file and checks each expected string is present. Both strings are absent from the modified file.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

File: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh
Line or code reference: 216-219 (removed _budget_suffix_for_now function), 406 (heartbeat emission line)
Problem: The _budget_suffix_for_now() function was deleted and the heartbeat emission line changed from CODEX_HEARTBEAT: phase={PHASE} elapsed_secs={elapsed}{_budget_suffix_for_now()} to CODEX_HEARTBEAT: phase={PHASE} elapsed_secs={elapsed}. The codex_heartbeat.sh wrapper still emits budget fields on its own heartbeat lines via its own independent _budget_suffix_for_now (line 151-161 of codex_heartbeat.sh), so the CODEX_HEARTBEAT contract is now inconsistent between the two heartbeat sources.
Why it fails at runtime: Operators and log-analysis tooling that grep stall-guard heartbeat lines for budget telemetry will silently stop receiving those fields. The codex_heartbeat.sh path is unaffected, creating a confusing split where some heartbeat lines have budget data and others do not.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

Requirement: "Contract tests pin the summary shape and log/summary-step wiring."
Expected change site: tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py and tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py
Evidence of absence: The PR removes budget helper functions from watchdog_helpers.sh and budget telemetry from codex_stall_guard.sh but does not update the corresponding tests in test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py (which still calls removed codex_run_budget_* helpers) or test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py (which still asserts the old heartbeat format with budget fields).
